metrics.definition: MPPscan's count of MPP payments, mostly on Tempo.
metrics.caveat: Indexer's own definition; includes test and self-dealing traffic it cannot filter. A June 2026 article shows the same live figure, so it is not a June value.
About 0.11 USD per transaction on average.

metrics.metric: MPPscan unique senders and recipients, all time

metrics.caveat: Under one cent per transaction, which points to many tiny or test payments.

metrics.definition: Rolling 7-day window shown by default on the homepage.
metrics.caveat: Do not read the homepage numbers as all-time totals.

metrics.definition: Listings in mpp.dev/api/services; 126 accept tempo, 10 stripe, 1 evm.
Stars on the two main repositories.

costs.value: None defined in any MPP spec; costs come from the rail
costs.caveat: Rail and processor fees still apply.

costs.value: Paid in USD TIP-20 stablecoins through the Fee AMM; a 50,000-gas transfer costs at most about 0.0006 USD, with a quiet-period floor near 0.00003 USD
costs.whoPays: Client by default; server when feePayer is true for charge, open and topUp; server always for settle and close
costs.caveat: Depends on Tempo base fee parameters; fees go to the proposing validator.

costs.value: Open on an existing reserve balance 72.1 percent less gas (294,425 versus 1,055,229); settle to a new payee balance 79.4 percent more (559,871)
costs.caveat: Up to 72 percent is the best case for one operation, not an average.

costs.value: Stripe pays customers' Tempo network fees
costs.caveat: Needs mppx 0.9.2 or later, live mode and a Tempo deposit address on the same account; not with Connect.

costs.value: 0.50 USD for SPT card payments; 0.01 USDC for stablecoin payments
1.5 percent per transaction, reported at launch of stablecoin payments
costs.caveat: The current Stripe docs page states no percentage; whether it applies to MPP charges is unverified.

costs.value: Not published; SPT docs labeled Public preview
costs.caveat: Absence of a public schedule, not a zero fee.

costs.value: Card economics unchanged (interchange and acquirer fees); no MPP-specific card pricing published
costs.caveat: Inferred from Visa's announcement; no price list.
